result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers show the three themes side by side, with a correct light theme, a well-judged dark palette and +/− signs on amounts. B's screen is richer: it adds 'in'/'out' labels and category text, its high-contrast theme is clearly stronger (pure black, white borders, bright green button) and it says that all colours come from per-theme tokens. In A, the high-contrast theme differs from light mainly in border weight and slightly darker tones. Both high-contrast cards come out a few pixels taller because of thicker borders. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers show all three themes side by side with a faithful light theme and +/− signs on the amounts. A's high-contrast theme is clearly stronger, with pure black, bright green and coral, white borders and a vivid button, and its labels ('in'/'out', 'Recent') make the screen clearer. B's high-contrast theme differs from its light theme only through darker borders and slightly deeper colors, so it reads as a modest step up.
